questions.answer: The team for international students at FGV were very helpful, Carolina, Dario.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Could be easier. The university should look into finding host families for the students instead, for cheaper housing and a more local experience.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Pick a good area, Copacabana, Ipanema, Botafogo. Not all parts of Rio are great to live in

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: found mineon airbnb and had a great experience. but also met people at other schools in rio with local host families, that had way cheaper housing in good areas.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: They have a lot of stuff for the students but its a bit hard to become a part of as an exchange student, socially at least.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: They did a few intro social events, but honestly they could've done way more. It was kind of up to the exchange students themselves to organise

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: join the sports teams if you play sports

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Ilha Grande, Jericoacoara, Belo Horizonte. there are so many great places to see in Brazil

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: mainly the language barrier, people in rio are quite warm and open otherwise

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1. appreciate every moment because time goes by fast 2. say yes to a lot of things 3. don't be scared

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The people I met, the culture I encountered, the experience of Brazil and it's beauty; in nature, people, daily-life

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: language barrier, being far from family and friends, time-zones. but worth it
